text: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Brisbane. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

result.keyword: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Brisbane. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

items.markdown:
For a $10M luxury property in Brisbane, agencies with dominant ultra-prime track records include `Ray White New Farm` (led by top luxury specialists like Matt Lancashire), [Queensland Sotheby's International Realty](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/) , and Place Estate Agents (featuring high-profile agents like Drew Davies). These groups command high-net-worth buyer databases and elite prestige marketing.[[1]](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/)[[2]](https://theresearcher.com.au/best-real-estate-agents-brisbane/)

### Top Prestige Agencies in Brisbane

- **Ray White New Farm / Collective:** Renowned for handling landmark riverfront estates, heritage properties, and multi-million-dollar architectural homes, consistently setting top-tier price records in inner-east and riverside suburbs.[[1]](https://rwnf.com.au/agents/matt-lancashire/16194)[[2]](https://www.raywhite.com/matt-lancashire/real-estate-agent/matt.lancashire)
- **Queensland Sotheby's International Realty:** Offers powerful international and domestic reach through a premier global luxury network, making them ideal for connecting ultra-high-net-worth or overseas buyers with local $10M+ properties.[[1]](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/)
- **Place Estate Agents:** Strong local market share across Brisbane’s most affluent postcodes (such as Ascot, New Farm, and Hawthorne) with high-visibility digital campaigns and prominent high-end agents.[[1]](https://theresearcher.com.au/best-real-estate-agents-brisbane/)
- **Hailey McGrath / Consistently Active Boutiques:** Specialized local luxury operators and independent high-end agencies also frequently handle private, off-market transactions for elite properties in the $10M bracket.

If you'd like, share:

- The **suburb** your property is in
- Whether it is **riverfront** or a land-size/architectural estate
